{{italic title}}
'''''Winning Ways for Your Mathematical Plays''''' (Academic Press, 1982) by [[Elwyn R. Berlekamp]], [[John H. Conway]], and [[Richard K. Guy]] is a compendium of information on [[mathematical games]].  It was first published in 1982 in two volumes.

The first volume introduces [[combinatorial game theory]] and its foundation in the [[surreal numbers]]; [[partizan game|partizan]] and [[impartial game]]s; [[Sprague–Grundy theory]] and [[misère game]]s. The second volume applies the theorems of the first volume to many games, including [[nim]], [[sprouts (game)|sprouts]], [[dots and boxes]], [[Sylver coinage]], [[Phutball|phutball (philosopher's football)]], [[fox and geese]]. A final section on puzzles analyzes the [[Soma cube]], [[Rubik's Cube]], [[peg solitaire]], and [[Conway's Game of Life]].

A republication of the work by [[A K Peters]] split the content into four volumes.
